morning.insight:
💡 「유령입자와 7천선, 그리고 수요MBA의 날」

① 노벨 물리학상 '중성미자': 남극 얼음 속에서 우주 기원을 담은 고에너지 중성미자(유령입자)를 검출한 연구가 34년 만의 단독 수상의 영예를 안았습니다. 광유전학(생리의학상)에 이은 기초과학의 시간. 내일(10/8) 화학상 발표가 이어집니다. 제니엘 AX·AI 투자 관점에서도 '불가능으로 취급되던 기초연구의 가치'를 재확인하는 사례입니다.

② 코스피 7천선 재이탈: 외국인이 1조7,720억원을 순매도하며 지수가 6,941.39(-0.89%)로 밀렸습니다. 반면 코스닥은 3개월 만에 900선을 회복(+2.98%)하며 소부장·바이오·보안주가 강세였습니다. 시장 온도차가 극명한 만큼, 개별 종목·섹터 선별이 중요한 국면입니다.

③ 미국 증시: S&P 500·나스닥이 사상 최고를 경신했습니다. 10년물 5.28% 고금리에도 AI 랠리가 버티고 있지만, 랠리가 소수 기술주에 편중됐다는 경계 신호가 나옵니다. 10/14 CPI가 다음 분수령입니다.

④ 오늘의 실천: 수요MBA의 날입니다. 강사로 나서는 팀이 있다면 사전 자료·발표 점검을 챙기세요. 업무일지 프로토타입 검토(Z-P2)와 사업계획 예산 설정(Z-P7)을 오전에 집중하고, 법무사 연락(E-P2)·창업센터 지원(E-P3)·『불변의 법칙』 사유 정리(L-P3)는 오후로 배분하면 좋겠습니다.

articles.headline: 초유의 '대법원장 국감'···조희대, '제2의 윤석열이냐' 질문에 "모욕적이고 슬프다"

articles.body: 조희대 대법원장이 6일 국회 법사위 국정감사에 출석해 증인선서를 거부하고, '제2의 윤석열'이냐는 질문에 '모욕적이고 슬프다'고 답했다. 대법원장이 국감에서 질의에 직접 답한 것은 1987년 재개 이후 처음이다.

articles.headline: 이 대통령 "농지 전용해 태양광사업하면 몇배 소득, 지금이 기회…정부가 시스템 만들어야"

articles.headline: 인권위, 환자 4명 숨진 정신병원 직권조사···병원장 고발·영업정지 첫 권고

articles.headline: 조현 "우크라 사과 메시지 받았지만···수위 미달" 주우크라 대사 소환 검토

articles.body: 조현 외교부 장관이 북한군 포로 비공개 송환을 둘러싼 갈등에서 우크라이나로부터 사과 메시지를 받았지만 수위가 미달이라며 주우크라이나 대사 소환을 검토 중이라고 밝혔다.

articles.body: 조희대 대법원장이 국감에서 증인선서를 거부한 채 준비해 온 원고를 꺼내 6분여간 작심 발언을 이어갔다. 그는 대법관 제청 과정의 국회·대통령 간섭을 두고 '위헌'을 6차례 언급했다.

articles.body: 올해 노벨 물리학상은 남극 얼음 속에서 우주 기원의 고에너지 중성미자를 포착한 미국 연구자에게 돌아갔다. '유령입자'로 불리는 중성미자 관측이 우주의 비밀을 푸는 단초가 될 것으로 기대된다.

articles.headline: '페스트균 시험관 깨졌다' 러 연구원 폐렴 사망…'21세기 흑사병' 공포

articles.body: 러시아 시베리아 페스트 연구소에서 여성 연구원이 원인 불명의 폐렴으로 숨져 페스트균 감염 가능성이 제기됐다. 미국은 신속하고 투명한 정보 공개를 요구하고 나섰다.

articles.headline: 中, 美거주 대만총통 아들에 '여성 감시자' 붙였다
articles.eng: China monitored Taiwan leader's son in US
articles.body: 중국이 미국에 거주하는 대만 총통의 아들을 감시하기 위해 캘리포니아 여성을 시켰다는 FBI 발표가 나왔다. FBI는 상하이행 비행기에 오르려던 여성을 체포했다.

articles.headline: 삼전하닉 핵심 27명 中 CXMT로…이직후 3년도 안돼 퇴출

articles.headline: 보안 인력 1%도 안 됐다…해킹 사태가 드러낸 은행 현실

articles.body: 국내 은행의 보안 인력이 전체 직원의 1%도 안 되는 것으로 나타나 금융권 AI 해킹 사태 이후 보안 투자 부족이 도마에 올랐다. 3대 신평사가 보안 체계 집중 점검에 나섰다.

articles.headline: 코스닥, 석달 만에 900선…소부장·바이오·배터리 강세
articles.eng: KOSDAQ back above 900 on biotech, parts rally
articles.body: 코스닥이 약 3개월 만에 종가 기준 900선을 회복했다. 소부장·바이오·배터리 업종이 강세를 보이며 외국인과 기관의 동반 순매수를 이끌었다.

articles.headline: 美국채 수요 둔화 조짐…금리 상승에도 엔비디아는 건재
articles.eng: US bond demand softens but Nvidia holds up
articles.body: 미국 국채 수요 둔화 조짐에도 금리 상승 국면에서 엔비디아가 견조한 흐름을 이어가고 있다. AI 랠리가 국채 금리 상승 부담을 상쇄하는 구도다.

articles.headline: '일할 시간' 사라진 저임금 근로자…월급 격차 더 커졌다
articles.eng: Low-wage workers lose hours, widening pay gap
articles.body: 저임금 근로자의 일할 시간이 줄면서 소득 격차가 더 벌어진 것으로 나타났다. 최저임금·주52시간제가 저소득층에 부담으로 작용한다는 지적이 나온다.

articles.headline: France's Appetite for 'Magic Money' Has Turned Into a Debt Bomb
articles.body: After years of overspending, France has emerged as one of Europe's weakest links, and investors are bracing for things to get worse as the country's bond market comes under pressure.

articles.headline: S&P 500 Closes at Record High
articles.body: Stocks rose with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq closing at record highs. The S&P climbed to 7,819, its first end-of-day high since August, on earnings optimism.

articles.headline: U.S. Escalates Pressure on Russia Over Siberia Lab Death
articles.body: The U.S. has warned Moscow that its failure to disclose details about the death of a researcher at a Siberian plague lab violates international health obligations.

articles.headline: Google and Constellation Energy Strike a Sweeping Nuclear-Power Deal
articles.body: Google and Constellation Energy struck the largest-ever 'uprate' project, one that squeezes more power out of existing reactors, between a nuclear-power provider and a tech company.

articles.headline: Former German Spy Chief Arrested on Suspicion of Espionage
articles.body: A former German spy chief has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, deepening security concerns across Europe as Berlin warns of Russia's escalating shadow war.

articles.headline: The Surge in Rates Is Blowing Up Commercial Real-Estate Deals
articles.body: Property buyers are demanding sellers renegotiate terms due to higher mortgage rates, signaling broader distress across the commercial real-estate market.

articles.headline: S&P 500 Climbs to Record High on Earnings Optimism
articles.body: Wall Street traders drove stocks to all-time highs on growing bets that Corporate America can weather still-elevated energy costs and interest rates.

articles.headline: Deeply Distressed US Loans Rise to Highest Level Since Pandemic
articles.body: Technology is the single biggest sector under pressure as deeply distressed U.S. loans climb to their highest level since the pandemic, JPMorgan says.

articles.headline: Trump Says He's Considering Gas Tax Suspension to Ease Costs
articles.body: President Trump said he is considering suspending the federal gas tax, part of an effort to ease consumer costs ahead of the midterm elections.

articles.headline: Ray Dalio Warns China, Japan May Pull Back From Treasuries
articles.body: Ray Dalio warned that China and Japan may pull back from U.S. Treasuries as public debt tops $40 trillion and yields hit multi-decade highs.

articles.headline: BofA Analysts See Tech Bubble Brewing But Advise Clients to Pile In
articles.body: Bank of America analysts see signs of a tech bubble brewing but are still advising clients to pile in, underscoring the momentum behind the AI trade.

articles.headline: US Senate Map Moves in Democrats' Favor as Kansas Rated 'Tossup'
articles.body: The U.S. Senate map has shifted toward Democrats as nonpartisan analysts moved Kansas to 'tossup', tightening the race for control of Congress.

articles.headline: Spain Clears Way for Separatist Leader to Return to Catalonia
articles.body: The Spanish Supreme Court canceled an arrest warrant for Carles Puigdemont, who has been living in self-imposed exile in Belgium.

articles.headline: Midterm Elections: Who Is Winning the Race for Congress? Latest Data
articles.body: With a month to the midterms, the New York Times data team breaks down which party is favored to win control of the House and Senate.

articles.headline: FIFA Found Congo Player Ineligible but Let Him Play in World Cup
articles.body: Officials determined that a Democratic Republic of Congo goalkeeper did not have the correct paperwork but allowed him to play in the World Cup, documents show.

articles.headline: Democratic Effort Aims to Keep 2028 Hopefuls Focused on General Election
articles.body: A new polling project called Project 270 will work to focus presidential hopefuls on voters' interests in battleground states.

articles.headline: There's Another Cockpit Israelis Need to Rush
articles.body: An opinion column ties the FlyDubai cockpit attack to the third anniversary of the Oct. 7 massacre, arguing Israelis must confront the country's unresolved divisions.

articles.headline: Election Dispatches: Candidates in Crucial Maine Senate Race Set to Debate
articles.body: Three major Senate races have shifted toward Democrats, according to the Cook Political Report, as candidates in Maine prepare to debate.

articles.headline: Protests sweep France, as student walkouts tap into public discontent
articles.body: A nationwide day of protest follows more than two weeks of demonstrations and blockades over school conditions, with more than 5,000 people detained.

articles.headline: Escalating a 'war' in Europe, Putin aims to end its support for Ukraine
articles.body: With hybrid attacks and nuclear bluster, Vladimir Putin is escalating a shadow war in Europe aimed at ending Western support for Ukraine.

articles.headline: Susan Collins, who's depended on winning Trump's haters, faces her biggest test
articles.body: In her bid for a sixth term representing Maine, Susan Collins has been beset by President Trump weighing her down with constant controversy.

articles.headline: Obama-era DOJ official to lead review of Cornell response to rape allegations
articles.body: Sally Yates will lead an independent review of Cornell University's response to rape allegations, after student protests and a possible no-confidence vote.

articles.headline: Intelligence on potential Iranian drone attack led U.S. to move bombers
articles.body: Multiple streams of intelligence warned of possible Iranian drone attacks on a U.K. base, prompting the U.S. to relocate its B-1 bombers.

articles.headline: Justice Alito says he won't retire during lame-duck session of Congress
articles.body: Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito said he will not retire during the lame-duck session of Congress, defusing speculation about a pre-election vacancy.

articles.headline: Ships' captains paid $100,000 a month to transit Strait of Hormuz
articles.body: Salaries and bonuses are spiraling for seafarers willing to risk the perilous trip through the Strait of Hormuz in the face of Iranian attacks.

articles.headline: S&P 500 hits record high as AI stocks shrug off bond market slump
articles.body: Wall Street's benchmark index closed at a fresh peak, but the rally is increasingly reliant on a handful of tech stocks.

articles.headline: Goldman Sachs and Man Group exposed in EY data breach
articles.body: Disclosures widen the circle of victims of a hacking incident earlier this year, with Goldman Sachs and Man Group the latest exposed.

articles.headline: Former German spy chief arrested for treason
articles.body: Ex-intelligence head August Hanning is suspected of selling state secrets to a foreign power, deepening Europe's security crisis.

articles.headline: Paramount closes $111bn takeover of Warner Bros
articles.body: Paramount completed its $111bn takeover of Warner Bros, with heavy cuts expected as boss David Ellison seeks $6bn of cost savings at the combined group.

articles.headline: AI models used in bank cyber attacks, warns South Korea's president
articles.body: South Korea's president warned that AI models are being used in bank cyber attacks, as the country grapples with a wave of breaches across its financial sector.
